decisive_items: lesions followed the course of branches of the common plantar digital nerves
small extension of high signal from the lateral aspect of one lesion resembled a “mouse-tail”
response.rationale: Multiple nodules along nerve distribution with imaging 'mouse-tail' sign strongly indicate plexiform schwannoma; glomus tumor typically solitary subungual with cold sensitivity but lacks nerve-course pattern; neurofibroma less likely given no NF history and imaging features.

rejected.why: No neurofibromatosis family history and imaging favors nerve sheath tumor with plexiform pattern rather than neurofibroma.
Cold/exacerbation pain could suggest glomus, but multiple nodules along digital nerves and MRI features are not typical of glomus tumor.
